strings.Режиссёры монтажа, дизайнеры, моушн, фот: Video editors, designers, motion artists, photographers, SMM and AI creators — all in one app. Describe your task, get responses, agree on the details in chat.

strings.Для заказчиков — да: скачать приложение,: For clients, yes: downloading the app, creating a profile and posting a task are free. Creators also get a free profile, portfolio and responses; the only paid option is “Open number”, which shows the client’s phone number.
strings.Режиссёров монтажа, графических и моушн-: Video editors, graphic and motion designers, photographers, videographers, SMM specialists, AI creators and scriptwriters.
strings.Основная база специалистов — Алматы и Ас: Most specialists are based in Almaty and Astana, but many work remotely across Kazakhstan.
strings.Как стать исполнителем?: How do I become a creator?
strings.Скачай приложение, заполни профиль, доба: Download the app, fill in your profile, add your portfolio and respond to tasks.
strings.Цену определяете вы с исполнителем. Укаж: You and the creator agree on the price. Set a budget in your task — creators will offer their terms in their responses.
strings.Как проходит оплата работы?: How is the work paid for?
strings.Напрямую между заказчиком и исполнителем: Directly between the client and the creator: you agree on the price, deadlines and payment terms yourselves in chat.
strings.Как выбрать надёжного исполнителя?: How do I choose a reliable creator?
strings.Смотри портфолио и отзывы в профиле, фик: Check the portfolio and reviews on their profile, put agreements in writing and don’t pay the full amount upfront before work starts.
